g.title: setup
g.text: Prepare the actual project geometry, mesh and boundary conditions
Set the imposed-displacement history and solver controls
Load the compiled USERMAT library through ANS_USER_PATH
Define TB,USER properties and at least four TB,STATE variables

g.title: start
g.text: Begin or retry a load substep
Use the last accepted stress and material history

g.title: propose
g.text: ANSYS predicts / corrects the nodal displacement solution

g.title: strain
g.text: Compute strain increments at integration points
relative to the start of this substep

g.title: local
g.text: Call USERMAT for the local material update → view B
The JC-PINN evaluator inside it is expanded in view C

g.title: assemble
g.text: For successful local updates: assemble element contributions
into the global internal-force residual and tangent stiffness

g.title: error
g.text: Report a material error through ANSYS erhandler
This local update is not a successful return
See explicit error paths in B and C

g.title: accept
g.text: Commit its material history and save requested results

g.title: cutback
g.text: Bisect / reduce the substep and retry

g.title: notes
g.text: Small-strain structural analysis; no training inside the solve.
The saved bracket study uses imposed UX, not an invented service force.
Global iteration / recovery policy belongs to ANSYS, not to the neural network.
A successful solve is not experimental validation or mesh convergence.
